_note: RULES569 idea 3 ALONE on today's page (R1 failed its trial, so the links are measured without it): THE BARS AFFECT EACH OTHER, four links, each read once at the start of the beat. (1) HEALTH -> STAMINA BAR (owner: 'maybe lower health limits your stamina pool'): each third of his health lost takes 1 off the top of his stamina bar, as a body shot does (never under 4). (2) STAMINA -> PUNCHES: a man who starts a beat on 2 stamina or less has tired arms - his punches of 2 or more do 1 less. (3) GUARD -> BLOCKS: a man who starts a beat on 2 guard or less has a soft guard - a punch of 3 or more that he blocks lets 1 through (never his last health). (4) GROUND -> GUARD: on the ropes every punch he blocks takes 1 more guard. docs/RULES569_RESULT.md.
